frames.caption: The corridor from 1700: Baroque on the left, Rococo on the right, the Atlas sky overhead
Rococo: pastel boiserie, gilt rocaille and mirrors
Neoclassicism: fluted columns and coffers, David and Ingres at real size
Romanticism: Gothic Revival ribs and amber light
Walk into The Raft of the Medusa (1819): depth-estimated relief
Impressionism under a glass roof
La Grande Jatte (1884) as 46,000 coloured points in depth
Walk into The Starry Night (1889)
Symbolism: gold mosaic and violet dark
Art Nouveau: whiplash ironwork under glass
The Pigment Tower, 1704 to 1868
Letters wing: life rails of 60 writers (gold = named in Western.Epic.md), books at their publication year
Ideas wing: 45 thinkers, tablets for The Wealth of Nations, Critique of Pure Reason, The Social Contract
Music wing: listening posts play public-domain scores, synthesised
Building wing: 30 buildings 1714 to 1889 as type models on plinths
Eiffel Tower (1889) at 1:20, rising through the glass roof
The Crystal Palace (1851), glass and iron
The Atlas sky: 595 lives across painting, letters, ideas, music and building; magenta = cross-field influence
Fly-to from the hang table: The Oath of the Horatii at real size (330 × 425 cm)
The page: view, painting card, rooms
